text:
emma: Planning to enable nova-m8-v2 in the model catalog during the 02:00-05:00 UTC change window on 2026-03-24. This is the float32->q4f16 quant step; goal is lower cost for standard traffic while keeping fp16 fallback for enterprise. Proposed canary: 1% (30m) -> 10% (30m) -> 50% (1h) -> 100%. Need fallback ordering, pin policy, and rollback criteria.

deploybot: @emma scheduled canary route 'catalog:nova-m8-v2-canary' at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z. Auto-promote unless a "hold" reaction is added within 30m of scheduling. I will create canary telemetry hooks and rollback webhooks per thresholds you specify.

michael: Recommend pinning nova-m8-v1 (fp16) as the top fallback for enterprise customers (those with reserved capacity). That keeps predictable latency while we validate q4f16. Also add nova-m8-v2-quant as secondary fallback for standard tiers.

carla: For rollback thresholds: p95 latency increase > 30% over baseline OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5 minutes should trigger rollback. Also add a short circuit: if tokenization mismatches exceed 0.2% overall on canary queries, immediate rollback.

sre-ops: Agree with thresholds. Add fallback TTL policy: if fallback is used continuously for >5 minutes for a given route, force a re-evaluation (don't leave traffic permanently routed). Deploybot should annotate the reason in the route audit.

devex: We'll need a short release note blurb and SDK note about variant selection and fallback precedence (param: model_variant, behavior: server chooses fallback chain). I'll draft and push to docs before the window.

ops-bot: Commit created: rollouts/1759001234-nova-enable.yaml (contains canary percentages, fallback_chain, alerts).

michael: Also suggest customer-tier pin keys: {"enterprise": "nova-m8-v1", "standard": "nova-m8-v2-quant"}. That keeps enterprise on the older fp16 variant by policy, avoids surprises for committed customers.

emma: Finalizing decision: fallback order by default: [nova-m8-v1 (fp16) pinned for enterprise], [nova-m8-v2-quant], [regional-fallback-route]. Canary cadence as above. Rollback triggers: carla's thresholds. Deploybot to perform automatic quick rollback to pinned fallback for affected routes and notify #runbook.

deploybot: Will create the pin entries and canary. Hooking automatic rollback to the p95/error/tokenization thresholds. Will send a deploy summary to #runbook and create tags: rollout=nova-m8-v2, change_window=2026-03-24-02:00-05:00Z.

carla: I'll own monitoring for the 02:00-06:00 UTC interval and will trigger manual rollback if I see noise before the automated thresholds fire. Manual rollback command: `/deploybot rollback catalog nova-m8-v2` — tested that command in staging earlier.

michael: Note for product: there is a tokenizer edge-case with a small subset of older prompts; put a compat shim in the release notes. Product should notify customers on the enterprise mailing list.

emma: @oncall please watch the rollout and be ready for intercept. Thanks. :thumbsup:

oncall: oncall ACK, I'll be on standby in #runbook during the window.

deploybot: Canary created and scheduled. Tags and hooks in place. Posting final summary in #runbook shortly.

emma: Thanks everyone — let's keep the channel pinned and call the rollback if telemetry moves.
